-- Settings, today's new urlscan.io scans, threat scale and the active recon
-- prompt, read once per run.
SELECT
    (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) FROM cyber_sentinel_ai.ai_settings) AS settings,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM cyber_sentinel_ai.deep_recon
      WHERE mode = 'submitted' AND started_at >= CURRENT_DATE)            AS submitted_today,
    (SELECT string_agg(formatted_line, E'\n' ORDER BY score)
       FROM cyber_sentinel.v_threat_scale_for_agent)                        AS threat_scale,
    (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(score, jsonb_build_object(
                'description', description, 'action', action_recommended))
       FROM cyber_sentinel.dic_threat_levels)                               AS threat_levels,
    p.version                                                               AS prompt_version,
    p.system_prompt
FROM (SELECT 1) AS one
LEFT JOIN cyber_sentinel_ai.recon_prompt_templates p ON p.is_active;

-- Claim ONE verdict before any external call: the 'running' row keeps a
-- failing domain from being picked again on the next run. Returns the
-- verdict as the main workflow stored it. No row = nothing to do, the run
-- ends here.
WITH next AS (
    SELECT * FROM cyber_sentinel_ai.v_pending_recon LIMIT 1
), claimed AS (
    INSERT INTO cyber_sentinel_ai.deep_recon (analysis_result_id, fqdn, observable_ip, original_score, original_label)
    SELECT analysis_result_id, fqdn, observable_ip, final_score, LEFT(threat_label, 50)
    FROM next
    RETURNING id, analysis_result_id, fqdn, observable_ip, original_score, original_label
)
SELECT c.id                     AS recon_id,
       c.analysis_result_id,
       c.fqdn,
       c.observable_ip,
       c.original_score,
       c.original_label,
       ar.verdict_summary_en    AS original_summary,
       va.rule_score,
       va.vt_malicious,
       va.primary_evidence,
       va.supporting_context,
       va.deviation_reason,
       va.evidence->'shodan'    AS shodan,
       va.evidence->'urlscan'   AS urlscan_search,
       va.analyzed_at,
       -- Subdomain of a platform where anyone can publish (github.io, ...):
       -- its registration data describes the platform, not the owner.
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cyber_sentinel_ai.domain_allowlist_exclusions e
               WHERE e.domain = ANY (cyber_sentinel_ai.domain_suffixes(c.fqdn))) AS shared_platform
FROM claimed c
JOIN cyber_sentinel_ai.verdict_audit va      ON va.analysis_result_id = c.analysis_result_id
JOIN cyber_sentinel.ai_analysis_results ar   ON ar.id = c.analysis_result_id;

-- Raw payloads (RDAP, urlscan.io) -> threat_data_raw, linked to the
-- verdict's indicator in threat_indicator_details (a urlscan.io scan
-- replaces the search payload the main workflow may have stored), then the
-- recon row is closed.
WITH rec AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS r
), raw AS (
    INSERT INTO cyber_sentinel.threat_data_raw (resource, source_provider, scan_date, raw_data)
    SELECT p->>'resource', p->>'source', LOCALTIMESTAMP, p->'payload'
    FROM rec, jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(rec.r->'raw', '[]'::jsonb)) AS p
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(p->'payload') = 'object'
    RETURNING id, source_provider, raw_data
), details AS (
    INSERT INTO cyber_sentinel.threat_indicator_details (indicator_id, source_id, raw_data_id, raw_response_hash, fetched_at)
    SELECT ti.id, sp.id, raw.id, encode(sha256(convert_to(raw.raw_data::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), LOCALTIMESTAMP
    FROM rec, raw
    JOIN cyber_sentinel.dic_source_providers sp ON sp.name = raw.source_provider
    JOIN cyber_sentinel.threat_indicators ti ON TRUE
    WHERE ti.analysis_result_id = (rec.r->>'analysis_result_id')::int
    ON CONFLICT (indicator_id, source_id) DO UPDATE
        SET raw_data_id = EXCLUDED.raw_data_id,
            raw_response_hash = EXCLUDED.raw_response_hash,
            fetched_at = EXCLUDED.fetched_at
    RETURNING id
)
UPDATE cyber_sentinel_ai.deep_recon dr
SET status                = 'done',
    registrable_domain    = r->>'registrable_domain',
    domain_registered_at  = (r->>'domain_registered_at')::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE current_setting('TimeZone'),
    domain_age_days       = (r->>'domain_age_days')::int,
    registrar             = LEFT(r->>'registrar', 200),
    cert_first_seen       = (r->>'cert_first_seen')::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE current_setting('TimeZone'),
    cert_count            = (r->>'cert_count')::int,
    page_status           = r->>'page_status',
    mode                  = r->>'mode',
    visibility            = r->>'visibility',
    scan_uuid             = r->>'scan_uuid',
    scan_time             = (r->>'scan_time')::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE current_setting('TimeZone'),
    report_url            = r->>'report_url',
    screenshot_url        = r->>'screenshot_url',
    final_url             = r->>'final_url',
    page_title            = r->>'page_title',
    urlscan_score         = (r->>'urlscan_score')::int,
    urlscan_malicious     = (r->>'urlscan_malicious')::boolean,
    page_type             = r->>'page_type',
    impersonated_brand    = r->>'impersonated_brand',
    credential_harvesting = (r->>'credential_harvesting')::boolean,
    supports_verdict      = r->>'supports_verdict',
    confidence            = r->>'confidence',
    proposed_score        = (r->>'proposed_score')::int,
    score_reason          = r->>'score_reason',
    summary_en            = r->>'summary_en',
    analysis_pl           = r->>'analysis_pl',
    indicators            = COALESCE(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r->'indicators')), '{}'),
    ai_status             = r->>'ai_status',
    ai_error              = r->>'ai_error',
    ai_model              = r->>'ai_model',
    prompt_version        = r->>'prompt_version',
    facts                 = r->'facts',
    message               = concat_ws(' · ', r->>'message', format('%s raw payload(s), %s indicator detail(s)',
                                    (SELECT count(*) FROM raw), (SELECT count(*) FROM details))),
    finished_at           = LOCALTIMESTAMP
FROM rec
WHERE dr.id = (rec.r->>'recon_id')::bigint
RETURNING dr.id, dr.fqdn, dr.status, dr.original_score, dr.proposed_score, dr.score_changed, dr.supports_verdict;

parameters.content:
# Cyber Sentinel — Deep Recon

Re-assesses verdicts scored >= `recon_min_score` with context the main workflow does not collect: domain registration (RDAP), certificate history (crt.sh) and the web page (urlscan.io loads it **from its own infrastructure**, never from this network). An AI analyst without tools proposes a score within `recon_max_deviation`. Nothing is changed automatically: the result goes to `cyber_sentinel_ai.deep_recon`, and an e-mail is sent when the proposed score differs.

Settings: `recon_*` in `ai_settings`; prompt: `recon_prompt_templates` — both edited in the AI config UI.

## Queue & budget
One verdict per run, hourly. The `running` row is written before any external call, so a failing domain is not retried in a loop.

## Domain: RDAP (two candidates, longest registered wins) + crt.sh certificate history
Both free, no key. Failures are recorded, never fatal.

## Page: reuse a recent urlscan.io scan, or submit a new one and poll for the result
No page (no key, refused, domain gone, timeout) → the analyst still runs with the domain context.

## Re-assessment (no tools) → database → e-mail if the score changed
Page text is attacker-controlled: data only, length-capped, URLs defanged. Score limit enforced in code.
